children: -- Cielo Waste Solutions Corp. (TSXV: CMC; OTCQB: CWSFF) (“
”) today announced the appointment of Ivy Chan as Chief Financial Officer of the Company, effective September 1, 2026.

The appointment follows the previously announced departure of Jasdeep K. B. Dhaliwal as Chief Financial Officer, effective September 1, 2026. The Company again thanks Ms. Dhaliwal for her contributions and support and wishes her well in her future endeavours.

Ryan C. Jackson, Chief Executive Officer of Cielo, commented, “Ivy brings a rare combination to the role. She is an engineer by training with an MBA and experience on large capital projects, which means she understands both what we are building and how it gets financed. That is exactly the skill set required as we advance our portfolio of clean fuels projects.”

Ms. Chan holds a B.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering and an MBA from the University of Calgary. She brings over 25 years of experience across the upstream, midstream, and downstream sectors, leading large-scale strategic projects across energy transition, infrastructure, and petrochemical sectors. She has facilitated commercial and joint venture arrangements for upstream oil and gas projects and has experience advancing project development from origination through financial close—structuring commercial agreements, securing capital, and aligning cross-functional teams, institutional investors, government agencies and Indigenous partners. Ms. Chan is recognized for translating strategic ambiguity into executable plans and delivering disciplined results across energy transition, CCS (carbon capturing and storage), petrochemicals, pipelines, and infrastructure.

is a clean fuels project development company advancing sustainable aviation fuel and other low-carbon energy projects across North America. Through the Nexus Platform, Cielo combines strategic feedstock partnerships with proven third-party technologies to develop a scalable pipeline of waste-to-fuels projects, anchored by its flagship Project Nahoonai in Prince George, British Columbia.
